title: Law requiring NYPD plan for school security perimeters
summary: This bill would require the NYPD to develop and publish a plan addressing how security perimeters are used at entrances and exits of elementary, middle and certain nonpublic high schools to guard against obstruction, intimidation and interference while protecting free speech and assembly rights. The Police Commissioner must submit a proposed plan within 45 days of the law taking effect and a final plan within 90 days, posting it on the NYPD website and providing a public point of contact.
